records.issue_text: [BUG] The light branch of .custom-message-length was inverted from scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%) to 30%, unlike the desktop/modal.scss counterpart which correctly preserves 70% in the light branch. Mobile light-theme modals render the custom-message-length hint at 30% lightness (near-solid, visually heavier than body text) instead of the previous subtle 70%, and mobile/desktop now disagree; the asymmetry with desktop/modal.scss line 94 confirms the arguments were swapped.
records.rationale: The diff shows mobile `custom-message-length` changed from `color: scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%);` to `color: dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 70%));` (mobile/modal.scss). In contrast, desktop keeps `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 30%));` (desktop/modal.scss). This indicates the mobile light-theme branch was inverted to 30% while desktop preserves 70%, causing an unintended mismatch and likely heavier text in mobile light theme.
